admission.justification: Proved by two integration tests, needed for the standalone PR end family, and prevents marking a master Completed before cleanup succeeds over an uncleaned worktree or broken sprint row.

applicability: The worktree_cleanup branch of integration_branch_authority._require_series_task_terminal for direct worktree_cleanup and lifecycle_finalize_task cleanup.
conditions: A non-Completed series master is admitted to worktree_cleanup only when authority.sprint_ref is None, is_pr_landed_standalone_candidate(contract) holds, and pr_landed_standalone_blockers(contract, master_status=status) is empty.
lifecycle_finalize_task continues to run cleanup before marking task documents Completed, leaving documents untouched on cleanup refusal.
exclusions: The worktree_abandon branch of _require_series_task_terminal, which remains unchanged.
Sprint-commanded masters, locally integrated series, checkpoints, and abandoned masters, which remain refused by master-not-completed.
statement: The worktree_cleanup branch of _require_series_task_terminal admits a pull-request-landed standalone master passing Rule 2 while leaving the worktree_abandon branch and finalize's cleanup-before-task-documents order unchanged.
title: Cleanup admits PR-landed standalone masters before Completed
